notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to boost Devoted Druid's toughness by at least 2 without using +1/+1 counters.
description:
Boost Devoted Druid's toughness by at least 2 without using +1/+1 counters.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three -1/-1 counters from Devoted Druid, causing you to mill three cards and return a permanent with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
